articles.title: Oak Valley Community Bank Invests $1 Million in Access Plus Capital to Fuel Regional Small Business Growth

articles.summary: OAKDALE, Calif., April 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Oak Valley Bancorp (NASDAQ: OVLY) (the “Company”), the bank holding company for Oak Valley Community Bank and their Eastern Sierra Community Bank division, recently reported unaudited consolidated financial results for the first quarter of 2026. For the three months ended March 31, 2026, consolidated net income was $5,309,000, or $0.64 per diluted share (EPS).
